apps.name: Pep in Your Step
apps.tagline: Peptide reconstitution calculator and supplement dose scheduler
apps.description: Calculates peptide reconstitution math (concentration, draw volume, syringe units) and schedules recurring peptide/supplement doses with local reminders. Works fully offline.

apps.name: LevelUp
apps.tagline: Level up your life across nine categories
apps.description: A gamified personal-development tracker. Earn XP and level up across nine life categories, log activities and daily habits, schedule events, and track vices with streaks. Works fully offline.
